content: further, after the steps taken above, there are multiple email accounts, and I did also thereafter turn unify on for sent and draft folders (android). this resulted in random latest drafts and sent items showing in the unify inbox (on the android only) as the current time and date. deleting them resulted in them being deleted from their proper location on desktop and webmail, restoring them put them back erroneously in unified inbox on android. turning off sent and draft (android) unify seems to have cleared that part back up. again seems like a low level caching issue, only TB android is affected. other phone apps do not recreate the issue.
